quote: We evaluate bias across three MLMs ... and focus on bias mitigation rather than NLG tasks.
Bias is quantified using the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between the predicted distribution ... Perplexity and GLUE scores are also reported.

To assess whether our bias mitigation impacts language modeling, we evaluated model performance on two external corpora: the GAP Corpus  and WikiText-103 (development and test sets) . For MLMs, we report MLM loss; for ALM, we report sentence perplexity, which reflects next token prediction quality.
